intent: Publish and verify a zero-runtime-capacity AWS career sandbox with human-approved GitHub OIDC deployment
source_limitations: No agent may run cdk bootstrap or cdk deploy
No ECS service or task execution, VPC, load balancer, database, cache, secret, DNS mutation, or Bedrock resource
No static AWS key or environment secret
The one-time trust and CDK bootstrap ceremony belongs to the human operator
logic_constraints: Fail closed unless repository, audience, and protected environment subject match exactly
Only the deployment job receives id-token write
The deployment job cannot begin before GitHub environment approval
Every deploy records identity, diff, outputs, stack descriptions, actor, SHA, and workflow run
